metadata.title: Sharp fill-in inequalities and rigidity for spin initial data sets
metadata.abstract: We prove sharp fill-in inequalities for compact spin initial data sets satisfying the dominant energy condition. The inequalities relate the spacetime mean curvature of the boundary to its hyperspherical radius and stable one-systole. Equality characterizes spacelike graphs of constant boundary height over round Euclidean balls and, in the systolic case after passing to the universal cover, over products of a round disk with Euclidean space. We also prove rigidity under comparison with strictly convex Euclidean domains, using normalized boundary metrics. The proofs use a modified Dirac operator with a chiral boundary condition.
